title: chore(ts-migration): adds api extractor for type definitions
body:
This pull request replaces the current experimental type definitions system by api extractor. Keep in mind, with this pull request, type definitions will be generated on the stable tag ( instead of the experimental one ). 

Now, once you run `yarn:build` the type definitions will be generated for the package:

```
Writing package typings: /Users/nunomaduro/Algolia/instantsearch.js/dist/index.d.ts
Warning: temp/types/index.d.ts:5:5 - (ae-forgotten-export) The symbol "InstantSearchOptions" needs to be exported by the entry point index.d.ts
Warning: temp/types/index.d.ts:5:5 - (ae-forgotten-export) The symbol "InstantSearch" needs to be exported by the entry point index.d.ts
Warning: temp/types/index.d.ts:7:5 - (ae-forgotten-export) The symbol "snippet" needs to be exported by the entry point index.d.ts
Warning: temp/types/index.d.ts:8:5 - (ae-forgotten-export) The symbol "highlight" needs to be exported by the entry point index.d.ts
Warning: temp/types/index.d.ts:9:5 - (ae-forgotten-export) The symbol "insights" needs to be exported by the entry point index.d.ts
```

The errors are normal, mean that API Extractor is doing his job. They are going to be addressed in a different pull request.
